name: Gram [anylinux]
description:
Gram is a modern, lightweight source code editor designed for speed, elegant typography, and distraction-free writing. It provides responsive text editing with intelligent syntax highlighting across many languages.

Features:
- Fast startup and responsive typing performance with low resource usage
- Built-in syntax highlighting for popular programming and scripting languages
- Multiple tab and pane support for simultaneous document navigation
- Project file tree and quick file switcher for seamless workflow
- Clean, customizable dark and light aesthetic color themes

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
